scope: 32 standalone entry-trigger plus one state-condition combinations. No ladder, HL, SR, exit optimization or live changes. Review this card before simulations.
inputContract: Verify I01 manifest source/input hashes and accepted artifact hashes before loading the same repaired minute history. Drift is a stop, not permission to substitute the latest pull. Reproduce every named parent/control ledger, stats and monthly series before new results.
funding: Excluded: incomplete settlement evidence. Modeled fees, before funding; not account-net certification. Fee is the inherited research assumption, not a current account rate lookup.
timing: A fresh closed-bar crossing at t; B uses its latest EXPECTED fully closed source bar ending floor(t/timeframeMs)*timeframeMs. Missing/null expected bar blocks, never fall back to an older one. Source availableAt <= t. Model historical zero publication lag and a separate +60s execution delay for BOTH entries and exits. Freeze A/B at t; do not refresh B while entry is pending. No execution-minute H/L/C at the decision.
inventory: One independent position per definition, fixed notional, no averaging or compounding. B false discards the A crossing permanently; occupied/pending crossings skipped, not queued. Timeout 12h from actual entry then exit delay. Preserve inherited same-timestamp event ordering. Mark cutoff inventory including hypothetical closing fee, never invent a completed close.

anchors.hypothesis: Can bearish context distinguish fading an up-volume burst from shorting a sustained uptrend? Only13 recent parent closes, concentrated gains.

conditions.meaning: 4h +DI>-DI for long, -DI>+DI for short; equality fails. No extra ADX threshold.
conditions.caveat: A7 already uses bearish30m DI; B1 is higher-timeframe agreement, not an independent indicator vote.

conditions.meaning: No strongly efficient20h move against entry. SignedER=(C[t]-C[t-20])/sum20 absolute close changes; zero travel is valid0. Equality fails.
conditions.caveat: An adverse-path veto, not a guarantee of trend recovery or a volatility threshold.

conditions.meaning: Closed1h base volume at least1.5x mean of PRIOR20 completed1h volumes; current excluded from denominator. Zero denominator null/blocked; zero current volume valid0/false.
conditions.caveat: No inherent direction. Tests participation at A, not an independent buy/sell signal; no fabricated B-only directional rule.

conditions.meaning: Latest completed1h close above its UTC-day actual-turnover VWAP for long, below for short; equality fails. Carry that closed source bar's own day anchor, never a forming current-day VWAP.
conditions.caveat: At00:15UTC the last complete1h bar belongs to the previous day. Log its day anchor explicitly. This state filter does not require a new VWAP cross.

controls.primary: Each exact A-alone parent; additionally A plus B-data-ready-only on the identical information support, with no B threshold. Compare both, never treat missing data as successful selection.
controls.secondary: Six existing B-directional-cross definitions above; these cross-entry diagnostics are not persistent-state equivalence. B3 alone is non-directional and has no invented trade rule. Two inherited I01 clock controls plus cash context.
controls.availabilityControls: 32 logical pair controls (128 window/delay slots); may reuse an exact parent only if all relevant event/ledger/monthly/stats equality is established. Log logical slots, actual runs and deduplications.
controls.scaledParent: Descriptive constant-notional rescaling of availability-parent minute PnL/fees/marks to match each combination's dollar-hours exposure. Recompute DD from scaled equity, do not multiply DD percentages. Report ratio, exposure and returns. Full-sample-derived diagnostic, not a causal strategy or matched entry-time control. No randomized filter search in C01.

shortlistProposal.common: Each delay: >=30 full and >=10 recent completed trades; positive net and extra-cost-stressed net; solvent; parity, timing and independent accounting checks passed. Max negative marked monthly delta to BOTH own parent and availability-parent $320 (1% initial equity), including partial months. No missing-data-driven promotion.
shortlistProposal.profit: Every window/delay: positive delta to BOTH parents; at least+$500 full and+$200 recent; max adverse DD no worse than availability-parent.
shortlistProposal.defensive: Every window/delay: retain>=90% of positive own-parent AND availability-parent net, reduce absolute losing-trade dollars versus both. Each full delay: max adverse DD reduced>=20% relative AND>=1 percentage point versus availability-parent; recent DD no worse. Must also beat exposure-scaled availability-parent on both DD and losing dollars, or label reduced exposure only, not demonstrated selection benefit.
shortlistProposal.strictDiagnostic: Separately retain inherited I01-I11 screen versus own-side clock, including no negative monthly deltas. Passing the proposed research shortlist is not passing this stricter screen or repo deployment gates.
shortlistProposal.ranking: Profit: descending minimum of the four full net deltas (two parents times two delays). Defensive: descending minimum full DD percentage-point reduction versus availability-parent across delays. Ties: minimum recent net across delays then lexical ID. A rule passing both takes one slot. Cluster identical/similar signal ledgers; disclose overlap, don't count correlated parents as independent confirmations.
shortlistProposal.followupLimit: Up to4 distinct mechanism representatives, initially at most2 per track; do not pad failing/sparse cases. Review results before a separate bounded card; proposed next cap12 new refinements, at most3 per selected mechanism, one axis at a time. Failed/sparse exact rules remain recorded, not family-wide rejections.

deliverables: Immutable manifest with source/card/input hashes and every exact ID; no overwrite of accepted runs
Parent/combination baseline-first W/L counts, winning and losing dollars, open mark, total net, fees, DD, exposure and cost/delay cases
All32 failure reasons and full monthly side-by-side parent/variant/delta for both windows/delays; top5 plus every shortlisted rule highlighted
Decision ledger including every A crossing, source bar availability, B value/readiness, occupancy/rejection, linked parent/candidate trade IDs
Blocked parent winners and losses separately from newly enabled/missing candidate trades; independent full-path replays, not masking old trade totals
Worst MAE/DD paths, top5 winner concentration, calendar attribution and baseline-scaled exposure diagnostics
Independent result/path verification and prefix-invariance tests before accepted findings/register updates
deferrals: No new RSI/ROC/Bollinger/ATR entry grids in this batch; not rejected families. Stochastic/%R, Donchian/Keltner, CHOP and other pending guide items explicitly deferred for C01. No TP-atlas-derived clock filters; HL/SR reserved for selected mechanisms on matched healthy overlap later. No combinations of three features, wait-for-confirmation variants, exit/sizing grids, or simultaneous long/short portfolio in C01.
limitations: Both windows were previously mined, recent is a subset, eight parents were chosen using I01-I11 results. Not fresh out-of-sample proof. Entry conditions are correlated candle proxies. A positive standalone result is not incremental ladder/account profit. Generic timestamps/formulas should remain pair-agnostic, but findings here are HYPE-specific.
